summary: Published a public README walkthrough showing how to inspect and smoke-run a runx registry skill, with links to runx.ai, the upstream runx repository, the registry page, and the related pull request.
audience: Developers and maintainers evaluating portable skills, governed execution, and receipt-verifiable agent workflows.
why_allowed: The artifact is in the operator's own public fork as a relevant README/example. It does not post into a third-party community, request reciprocal engagement, or use star-only/screenshots-only evidence.

observations.name: venue
observations.value: Public GitHub README/example in ReluctantSkeptic/runx on branch runx-love-walkthrough.

observations.name: runx_project_links
observations.value: The README links to https://runx.ai and https://github.com/runxhq/runx.

observations.name: specific_support_action
observations.value: The README explains the escalation-judge registry artifact, the install/run smoke path, the public PR, and why runx receipts and pinned source are useful.

observations.name: not_star_proof
